title: Barkley Marathons 2025
publisher: barkley.ferrett.io（粉丝维护的赛事追踪页）
claims: The 2025 Barkley Marathons has ended. There are no finishers.
The conch was blown at Mar 18, 2025 10:37, so the race started at Mar 18, 2025 11:37, and the race ended at Mar 20, 2025 23:37.
2025 年赛果表中，John Kelly 完成三圈 Fun Run，第三圈完成时间记为 39:50:27。
You can't start a loop after its cutoff.
